history.period: 1128 CE per local tradition; Wikipedia infobox says 1150 (CONFLICT - verify)
history.summary: Patnadevi, 18 km southwest of Chalisgaon inside the Gautala Autramghat Sanctuary, was the capital of the old Patna (Vijjalgad) province under the Yadav kings and their tributaries. The Chandika Devi temple was built by the Yadav mandlik kings (creation credited to Yadavrao Kheunchandra and Govindraj Mourya); a Hemadpanthi Mahadev temple stands beside it. Founding-date sources conflict (1128 vs 1150). Patnadevi is also claimed as the birthplace of the mathematician-astronomer Bhaskaracharya (UNVERIFIED - treat as local tradition). Coordinates below are from Wikipedia (20.33003N, 74.967424E) and are approximate.

name: Patnadevi (Chandikadevi) Temple
town_description: Patnadevi is a historic hill site about 18 km southwest of Chalisgaon in Jalgaon district, lying inside the Gautala Autramghat Wildlife Sanctuary in the Sahyadri hills. It was once the walled capital of the Patna (Vijjalgad) province, famed for trade, metal mines and temples. Chalisgaon itself is a taluka town and railway junction in Jalgaon district. NOTE: CSV town 'Jalgaon' corrected to Patnadevi, Chalisgaon.
